summary.text: Devan Seabaugh was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in a special election in July 2021 and represents House District 34, which includes west Cobb County and parts of Marietta and Kennesaw.

paragraphs.text: Seabaugh is a career paramedic and a healthcare executive with Metro Atlanta Ambulance Service.
Seabaugh serves as a Governor's Floor Leader in the House.
